items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Mackenzie playing trumpet in the style of Art Farmer

ctx.x: Just before the concert started,the director's assistant came to my dressing room with a thermos bottle that was able to hold two cups of coffee. I could have been knocked over with a feather when I poured a drink in a glass and found out that it was half water. I came out of the dressing room and asked a young fellow who had not entered the concert hall if he would go to the nearest bar and bring me a double whiskey,and he did.

The hall could not hold about 120 people and it was full to capacity with important guests, notables, students and a few europeans. The first half of the concert was not too bad with the two guitars and Mackenzie playing trumpet in the style of Art Farmer and flute. I went to a bar near the hall when intermission time came, and the two guitar players must have done the same thing, because they did not remember much of any of the numbers that we had rehearsed. Mackenzie was trying to keep them straight without…

The organiser of the yearly "Jam Potatoes" festival in Luneray, Normandy, France, a Mr. Jean Suplice, found out that from the time I had bought my first horn and started to play and 1972, it happened to be 50 years.
